# Alert

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertAction, alertVariants } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para exibir mensagens iniciadas pelo sistema, persistentes e contextuais dentro do fluxo da interface.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Alert
  {...args}
  // Remount after a dismiss so changing a control brings the alert back.
  key={JSON.stringify(args)}
  icon={showIcon ? args.icon : false}
  actions={
    actionCount > 0 && (
      <>
        <AlertAction>Action 1</AlertAction>
        {actionCount > 1 && <AlertAction>Action 2</AlertAction>}
      </>
    )
  }
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Alert component: Color × Direction, with Title, Description (children), Icon, Actions and Dismissable as props.

## Variants

`alertVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `brand`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` | `brand` |
| `direction` | `inline`, `stacked` | `inline` |

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`Alert`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Title"; omit to hide it (Show Title). |
| `icon?` | `React.ReactNode \| false` | Figma "Icon"; defaults to the color's icon, `false` hides it (Show Icon). |
| `actions?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Actions": one or two <AlertAction>s. |
| `dismissible?` | `boolean` | Figma "Dismissable": shows the close button. |

## Rules

- Import `Alert` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
